mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(DEPT_ID) AS id, CASE WHEN PARENT_DEPT_ID IS NULL THEN '#' ELSE TO_CHAR(PARENT_DEPT_ID) END AS parent, DEPT_NAME AS text FROM DEPARTMENT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT ESNTL_ID as UNIQ_ID, 'USR01' as USER_TY, MBER_ID as USER_ID, MBER_NM as USER_NM, MBER_EMAIL_ADRES as EMAIL_ADRES, AREA_NO as AREA_NO, MIDDLE_TELNO as MIDDLE_TELNO, END_TELNO as END_TELNO, MBTLNUM as MOBLPHON_NO, GROUP_ID as GROUP_ID, MBER_STTUS as STTUS, SBSCRB_DE as SBSCRB_DE, d.Dept_id as dept_id, d.dept_name FROM COMTNGNRLMBER c join department d on c.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE MBER_STTUS = 'P'
